          <text x="325" y="486" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">core\task Manager</text>

          <text x="705" y="442" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">Ola/Uber Faculty Routing Engine</text>

          <text x="930" y="442" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#92400e" text-anchor="middle">Workload & Availability Calc</text>
          <rect x="595" y="464" width="140" height="36" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#f59e0b"/>
          <text x="665" y="486" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#92400e" text-anchor="middle">Pending Queue Task</text>

          <rect x="745" y="464" width="150" height="36" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#f59e0b"/>
          <text x="820" y="486" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#92400e" text-anchor="middle">Acuitey Event Observers</text>

          <rect x="905" y="464" width="130" height="36" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#f59e0b"/>
          <text x="970" y="486" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#92400e" text-anchor="middle">Custom Analytics</text>

        <g id="local-infra">

          <text x="95" y="562" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1e293b">Redis (Deployment to be finalized)</text>

          <text x="435" y="562" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1e293b">Hostinger /mnt/moodledata</text>
          <text x="435" y="580" font-size="11" fill="#64748b">Content-addressed filedir (Course docs, uploads)</text>

          <text x="775" y="562" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1e293b">Proposed Monitoring & Operations</text>

        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- EXTERNAL CONNECTORS TIER -->
      <g id="external">

        <rect x="50" y="665" width="280" height="75" rx="6" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="190" y="692" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">PostgreSQL / Supabase (To be confirmed)</text>
        <text x="190" y="710" font-size="11" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">Moodle relational tables + local_acuitey audit logs</text>
        <text x="190" y="726" font-size="11" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">Encrypted connections (SSL) · Point-in-time recovery</text>
        <line x1="190" y1="635" x2="190" y2="665" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

        <!-- Zoom LTI Integration -->
        <rect x="360" y="665" width="230" height="75" rx="6" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="475" y="692" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">Zoom LTI Pro (Live Class)</text>
        <text x="475" y="710" font-size="11" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">LTI 1.3 Advantage standard</text>
        <text x="475" y="726" font-size="11" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">Optional grade / attendance sync</text>
        <line x1="475" y1="635" x2="475" y2="665" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

        <rect x="620" y="665" width="230" height="75" rx="6" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="735" y="692" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1" text-anchor="middle">Razorpay Payment Gateway</text>
        <text x="735" y="710" font-size="11" fill="#0369a1" text-anchor="middle">UPI, Netbanking, cards</text>
        <text x="735" y="726" font-size="11" fill="#0369a1" text-anchor="middle">Server-side gateway verification</text>
        <line x1="735" y1="635" x2="735" y2="665" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>

        <!-- PhonePe Payment Gateway -->
        <rect x="880" y="665" width="220" height="75" rx="6" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="990" y="692" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6d28d9" text-anchor="middle">PhonePe PG Gateway</text>
        <text x="990" y="710" font-size="11" fill="#6d28d9" text-anchor="middle">Direct UPI intent & webhooks</text>
        <text x="990" y="726" font-size="11" fill="#6d28d9" text-anchor="middle">Seamless INR transactions</text>
        <line x1="990" y1="635" x2="990" y2="665" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
      </g>
    </svg>
